candidates.description: This vector represents common English prefixes, particularly those starting with 'c' or 'd'.
This feature activates for common French given names and masculine proper nouns.
This feature vector activates strongly on the French acute accent (é) and words or sub-words containing it.
These tokens are inflectional suffixes and morphological endings characteristic of Romance languages, particularly Spanish and Italian verb conjugations.
These tokens represent Italian words or suffixes ending in the letters "-ale", "-are", or similar rhyming morphological structures.
The tokens represent words and root fragments derived from Latin-based Romance languages, particularly Italian.
This vector activates on Italian prefixes and word stems, particularly those starting with "so" and related morphological roots.
The tokens share a common Latin-derived root or suffix pattern related to verbs and nouns ending in forms of "-liberate," "-operate," or "-orate."
This feature vector activates on tokens related to endings, conclusions, or the word root "fin/final".
This vector represents word-final or syllabic tokens ending with the sound "oo" or the letter "u", frequently appearing as parts of proper nouns, names, or foreign-language terms.
